Container.Name: notebook-postgres
Container.Overview: Dedicated PostgreSQL 17 database for Notebook. The database port is intentionally not published to the Unraid host; Notebook connects by container hostname on `notebook-net`.
Container.Description: Official PostgreSQL 17 image with persistent PGDATA and a container-local healthcheck.
Container.Requires: Create the custom Docker network `notebook-net` before installing this container. Keep POSTGRES_DB and POSTGRES_USER at their defaults unless you also update the healthcheck Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: Storage: PostgreSQL Data
Config.Description: Persistent PostgreSQL data directory. Prefer an SSD/NVMe appdata pool.

Config.Name: Basic: Database Name
Config.Description: Database created on the first startup.

Config.Name: Basic: Database User
Config.Description: Database superuser created on the first startup.

Config.Name: Security: Database Password
Config.Description: Required strong password. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32 and use the same password inside Notebook DATABASE_URL.

Config.Name: Basic: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone. Example for Perm/Yekaterinburg: Asia/Yekaterinburg.
